note: Which evidence rule a check made by an agent by hand follows, by the level of its plan row. Read when gate A makes a manual-agent row executable (planning_contract.manual_agent_pass) and its obligation names no evidence_policy of its own and its row names none. A level with `policy` is a level an agent can check by hand; a level with `refused` is not one, and the words say so. A level that is in neither list stays as planned and the gate line names it.
